latest_release.name: capd@4.0.13
latest_release.body:
Uses capjs-core 0.1.17, which stops flagging Firefox on Apple Silicon Macs with `shader_mismatch` (#363).

Dialogs and drawers in the dashboard now stay open when you click outside them after typing or changing a field, so a stray click no longer throws away your edits. Close them with the close button, Cancel or Escape (#364).
